title: Public package API design
description: Practice public package api design through an offline typed package/tooling scenario with runnable instructor tests, strict compilation and reviewed configuration evidence.
objectives: Explain the package or tooling contract behind public package api design
Repair a concrete module/toolchain bug without weakening type safety
Verify exported behavior, configuration or declarations using local TypeScript tests
rubric: I can describe how public package api design affects consumers of a package.
I repair the starter without publishing code or relying on cloud actions.
I check observable type/runtime behavior and note what is not yet a production release.
